Numerical definitions and algorithms are unchanged. The main imports FFT constants from their defining module and passes variables for the INOUT process-grid arguments. The generic double-precision CPU backend is checked in one MPICH process; no multi-process performance claim is made. A transient concurrent worker-file staging collision was resolved by running verification sequentially.
